row.notes: myteam-g2: Returns renown info for the player team: out[0] = current renown tier (count of tier thresholds <= renown points, thresholds from team renown data +0x18 config), out[1] = progress fraction toward the next tier (float stored in the int slot), out[2] = form value from Career_RenownData_ComputeFormLevel. Reads the data via Career_Get_TeamRenownData (renown points float at +4). Modder hook: renown points float at renown_data+4. CORRECTION(V9028): Tier = count of thresholds (vector at data+0x18 -> +8..+0x10) <= points (float at +4); progress = (pts-thr[i-1])/(thr[i]-thr[i-1]); out[2] = FUN_140f99080 (form level). Roles match, but the decompile stores progress with an (int) cast into out[1], so whether raw float bits are stored is unprovable here; progress is 0 at tier 0.
